form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Ms. Warren (for herself, Ms. Baldwin, Mr. Booker, Mr. Blumenthal, Ms. Duckworth, Mr. Markey, Mr. Sanders, Ms. Hirono, Mr. Durbin, Mr. Heinrich, Mr. Menendez, Mr. Casey, Mr. Fetterman, Mr. Whitehouse, Mr. Welch, Mr. Schatz, Mr. Luján, and Mr. Murphy) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To repeal title IV of the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Secure Viable Banking Act or the SVB Act.

Title IV of the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act (Public Law 115–174; 132 Stat. 1296) is repealed, and the provisions of law amended by that title are restored as if that title had not been enacted.
